name: Unfathomable Song

outcomes.criticalSuccess: The target is unaffected, can't be affected on subsequent rounds, and is temporarily immune for 1 minute.
outcomes.success: The target is unaffected this round, but it can be affected on subsequent rounds.
outcomes.failure: Roll onTable on the table below.
outcomes.criticalFailure: Roll onTable on the table below.

entries: Fleeting notes of a strange and unnatural song fill the air, overtaking the mind. Each target must attempt a Will save when you cast the spell, and again the first time you Sustain this Spell each round. A creature needs to attempt only one save against the song each round, and you have to keep the same targets when you Sustain the Spell.
2 | The target is confused for 1 round.
3 | The target is stupefied|stupefied 4 for 1 round.
4 | The target is blinded for 1 round.
5 | The target is stunned for 1 round and stupefied|stupefied 1 for an unlimited duration.
